name: Derelict
desc: A dead factory across a flooded yard, being taken back — the window openings are a grid of black voids with growth spilling out of them and a few panes still holding sky, ivy has climbed the facade and birch has taken the roofline, the standing water holds the whole shell upside down and keeps tearing it into sliding bands, and a low light walks across the elevation while more shells stand behind it in the haze; summer reclamation, a bare winter, a nocturne, an X-ray of the structure, or a cyan survey elevation.

energy.doc: how hard the light rakes the facade, how bright the sky is in the surviving glass, and the sparkle on the water

scale.doc: how big the hero shell stands — at max it fills the frame wall to wall and you are right under it

density.doc: how many shells stand behind, and how thick the birch, the scrub and the birds are

speed.doc: drift rate of the shells, the mist and the deck overhead

growth.doc: how far the reclamation has got — ivy up the facade, growth out of the openings, birch on the roof

hue.doc: the hue of what is growing; the masonry and sky key off it

x.doc: where the hero shell sits, and where the light comes from

y.doc: waterline across the yard as a canvas fraction — how much of the frame the reflection takes

style.doc: aesthetic: high summer, the green well into the building / bare winter, the growth stripped back to grey armature and the shell exposed / a nocturne, the voids blacker than the sky / an X-ray — the structure as a translucent negative, no local colour, the openings luminous / a cyan survey elevation of the shell, schematic and clinical

seed.doc: site lottery — window grids, which panes survive, the collapse of the roofline, where the birch stands
